description: StrategyConfig field catalogue for UI generation and validation tooling.

fields.title: Strategy Layer Enabled
fields.description: When False the entire strategy pipeline is bypassed.

fields.title: Config Version
fields.description: Schema version tag for this configuration object.

fields.title: Strategy Framework
fields.description: Named framework variant to apply (e.g. 'executive').

fields.title: Weight Policy
fields.description: How criterion weights are enforced. 'strict' requires enabled weights to sum to 1.0 ± 0.001; 'normalize' normalises at runtime.

fields.title: Score Precision
fields.description: Decimal places used when rounding theory scores.

fields.title: Minimum Winner Margin
fields.description: Score gap required to declare a clear winner over the runner-up.

fields.title: Saturation Threshold
fields.description: Score above which a theory is considered saturated.

fields.title: Tie Tolerance
fields.description: Maximum absolute score difference that is treated as a tie.

fields.title: Required Violation Policy
fields.description: How hard constraint violations are handled.

fields.title: Required Constraint Penalty
fields.description: Score deduction applied when a required constraint is violated.

fields.title: Preferred Constraint Penalty
fields.description: Score deduction applied when a preferred constraint is violated.

fields.title: Maximum Total Penalty
fields.description: Cap on cumulative constraint penalties per theory.

fields.title: Fail on Unknown Constraint Reference
fields.description: Raise an error if a constraint references an unknown theory or option.

fields.title: Option Mapping Enabled
fields.description: When False the option-mapping pass is skipped entirely.

fields.title: Unresolved Mapping Policy
fields.description: Behaviour when a theory cannot be mapped to any upstream option.

fields.title: Fail on Mapping Mismatch
fields.description: Raise an error when the mapped option does not match the upstream option.

fields.title: High Confidence Score Threshold
fields.description: Minimum score to qualify for High mapping confidence.

fields.title: High Confidence Margin Threshold
fields.description: Minimum margin over runner-up to qualify for High mapping confidence.

fields.title: Alignment Enabled
fields.description: When False the alignment pass is skipped entirely.

fields.title: Minimum Challenge Margin
fields.description: Score advantage the strategy selection must have over the upstream option to register as a 'challenged' alignment.

fields.title: Minimum Challenge Confidence
fields.description: Minimum mapping confidence required to declare a challenge.

fields.title: Unresolved Authority
fields.description: Which recommendation is authoritative when alignment is unresolved.

fields.title: Minimum Relevance Score
fields.description: Minimum score for a content item to be assigned to a theory.

fields.title: Minimum Content Coverage
fields.description: Fraction of available content items that must be assigned.

fields.title: Minimum Distinctive Coverage
fields.description: Fraction of content that must be distinctive (not shared) per theory.

fields.title: Allow Symmetric Fallback
fields.description: When True, shared content may be symmetric across theories.

fields.title: Partial Homogenization Threshold
fields.description: Shared-content fraction above which partial homogenization is flagged.

fields.title: Reporting Enabled
fields.description: When False the report assembly pass is skipped.

fields.title: Mandate Challenged Alignment Disclosure
fields.description: When True, challenged alignment must always appear in the report.

fields.title: Mandate Homogenization Disclosure
fields.description: When True, substantial homogenization must always appear in the report.

fields.title: Maximum Assumptions per Report
fields.description: Maximum number of assumption items shown per theory in the report.

fields.title: Maximum Risks per Report
fields.description: Maximum number of risk items shown per theory in the report.

fields.title: Unknown Reference Severity
fields.description: Diagnostic severity when an unknown theory/option reference is encountered.

fields.title: Low Mapping Confidence Severity
fields.description: Diagnostic severity when mapping confidence falls below the minimum.

fields.title: Partial Homogenization Severity
fields.description: Diagnostic severity when partial content homogenization is detected.

fields.title: Fallback-Heavy Severity
fields.description: Diagnostic severity when a theory relies heavily on fallback content.

fields.title: Insufficient Coverage Severity
fields.description: Diagnostic severity when coverage falls below the configured minimum.
